title: Combining
html:
See also: Alchemy

Combining is a crafting mechanic that allows for the creation of select Items through the combination of other items, and enables some environmental interactions.

Dyes

Main article: Dyes

The color of many pieces of equipment can be modified through the use of consumable Dyes. Interacting with a dye in inventory prompts the Combine Items interface, to which most any piece of equipment can be added.[1]

Items

Freely Craftable

These items can be crafted in inventory, regardless of location. Interacting with any of the constituent components in dialogue opens the Combine Items interface:

Mourning Frost

The  Mourning Frost can be crafted by combining:

  • Icy Crystal
  • Icy Helve
  • Icy Metal

Tarnished Ring

The  Tarnished Ring[2] can be crafted by combining:

  • Gemless Ring
  • Ringless Gem

Vision of the Absolute

The  Vision of the Absolute can be crafted by combining:

  • Head of a Broken Spear
  • Shaft of a Broken Spear

Location Specific

These items can be only be crafted by combining their constituent parts in an Environmental object. Interacting with the object opens the Combine Items interface:

Adamantine Equipment

Up to two items from the Adamantine set can be crafted in the ⁠Adamantine Forge as part of the quest ⁠Adamantine Forge by combining  Mithral Ore with one of the following moulds:

  • Longsword Mould
  • Mace Mould
  • Scale Mail Mould
  • Scimitar Mould
  • Shield Mould
  • Splint Mould

Hellfire Engine Crossbow

The  Hellfire Engine Crossbow can be crafted in the ⁠Steel Watch Foundry by combining:

  • Steel Watcher Arm
  • Targeting Module
  • Watcher Crossbow Blueprint

Shadow Lantern

The  Shadow Lantern can be crafted by  Gale in ⁠Balthazar's chambers from:

  • Broken Moonlantern
  • Dead Pixie

Sussur Weapons

One of the following three weapons can be crafted from a ordinary instance of the weapon and  Sussur Tree Bark in the ⁠Blacksmith's Forge as part of the quest ⁠Finish the Masterwork Weapon:

  • Sussur Dagger
  • Sussur Greatsword
  • Sussur Sickle

Location Access

There are locations where an item (or items) must be inserted to progress:[3]

  • ⁠Arcane Tower -  Sussur Blooms are required to activate the elevator
  • ⁠Gauntlet of Shar
    •  Umbral Gems are required to operate the levatating platform to the lower level, and unlock the door to ⁠The Verge of Shadows[4]
    • The  Lever Handle is required to fix a broken lift[5]
  • The ⁠Hidden Vault is unlocked by the  Rune of the Wolf
  • A secret room in ⁠Oskar's Atelier is unlocked by a  Blank Canvas.[verify]

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Some pieces of equipment are unaffected by dyes.
  2. ↑ This ring is unique, and distinct from other  Tarnished Rings.
  3. ↑ While ⁠Szarr Palace and the ⁠Temple of Bhaal also require a  Szarr Family Ring and  Amulet of Bhaal respectively, this is achieved through dialogue.
  4. ↑ The platform can be bypassed though  flying or  jumping from specific locations. The door to the Verge of Shadows can be opened with  Knock.
  5. ↑ This lift is distinct from the central platform, and entirely optional since the levels it connects are also linked by stairs.
